name: 阿蕾缇娅·尼伯莱茵
src: 迷宫纪前传/迷宫纪前传时段_四_深井的年月.md:213
who: Aletia Niberrain, a true dragon walking alone among mortals in human form, about four hundred and fifty-four years old, still young for a dragon, looking about twenty-six. Tall, about 182 cm, long-limbed and graceful, her back, shoulders and neck holding a strange, very old balance. Long silver-white hair with a warm ivory cast, worn loose to the waist; the last hand's length of it takes the colour of the weather, red in sunshine, blue in rain, violet before thunder, and here it is a soft red. Pale gold eyes with narrow dragon pupils that seem to lie under a layer of iridescent crystal. Two slim short horns at her temples, kept wrapped out of sight under a deep-blue headscarf. In this guise she shows no wings and no tail. A restrained, courteous air; she weighs every debt she owes.
build: 182 cm, tall, slender and light: long limbs, a medium bust, a narrow waist and gently rounded hips.
palette: silver-white and warm ivory, worn camel, deep indigo blue, gold-white, a faint shimmer of seven colours
casual: Her road clothes among mortals: an old pale camel travelling coat bought in a city, cut in the fitted, buttoned town style of the day, the cuffs fraying; under it a plain high-necked ivory wool dress to the shins and soft brown travelling boots; over her shoulders a long gold-white shawl, which no one would guess is her folded wings; the deep-blue headscarf wrapped over her temples, hiding the horns; at her waist a small cloth purse holding a few silver coins and a few dozen copper pennies. She holds one copper coin between two fingers, counting slowly, a calm, courteous look.
private: At the innermost low table of a bitter-leaf tea shop in the upper ring, where she sits until closing: the camel coat taken off, the high-necked ivory wool dress with long sleeves, the gold-white shawl loose around her shoulders, the deep-blue headscarf still on, soft shoes. She holds a small cup of the bitterest bitter-leaf tea in both hands, a quiet, contented look.
battle: Standing between the bone-shadows of the ancient dragon kings and the kneeling clans on the snow stairs: the camel coat belted tight over the ivory dress, the deep-blue headscarf taken off so that the two slim pale horns at her temples show, the gold-white shawl lifting from her shoulders and opening at its edges into translucent wing membranes banded in seven colours, fire, ice, stone, leaf, wind, water and storm, kept close behind her back; the ends of her hair glowing all seven colours at once. Her hands are open and empty, a faint glow of light around them; she carries no weapon.
battle_pose: 3) the battle outfit: standing her ground, unbowed, the shoulders squared, the feet planted, the chin raised, a still, unyielding expression, both hands open at her sides with a faint glow around them; she carries no weapon.
formal: Repaying a debt of courtesy in the city: a long deep-blue wool coat-dress in the fitted, high-collared town cut of the day, buttoned to the throat, with thin silver piping, soft grey gloves, the gold-white shawl draped over her shoulders, the deep-blue headscarf freshly tied over her horns, the little coin purse at her waist. She stands very straight with the hands folded in front, a grave, courteous look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the pale gold dragon eyes looking at the viewer over the rim of a small cup, a faint, courteous smile, the silver-white hair spilling across the frame with its ends tinted red, the deep-blue headscarf over her temples. Warm lamplight of a small tea shop from one side; far behind her, soft and out of focus, the lamps of a lower city going out one by one. Foreground blur: steam from the cup, a few copper coins and the edge of the gold-white shawl. She wears the worn camel travelling coat.
art_extra: Her hair is silver-white with a warm ivory cast from the roots down, exactly as in the sprite; only the last hand's length at the very ends turns a soft red; everything above that stays silver-white, NOT pink.

name: 维嘉·雪鳞
src: 迷宫纪前传/迷宫纪前传时段_四_深井的年月.md:269
who: Vega of the Snowscale clan, a dragonborn girl from a small clan that guards the lowest of the seven dragon gates, eighteen but looking sixteen or seventeen, since dragonborn age slowly: about 158 cm, sturdy, wholly covered by her clothes, standing very straight as if she meant to stand herself into a gate. Snow-white hair cut to the jaw, with one thin braid on the left falling to her chest, worn only by the one who keeps the clan's vow. Ice-blue eyes with narrow vertical slit pupils. A layer of fine pale scales, the colour of the gate stone, on both forearms, along the sides of the neck and on the palms of both hands. An earnest, direct, stubborn air; she pauses before every answer.
face: FACE, as in the references: a youthful, earnest face of about sixteen, NOT a child's: medium, sharp, gently slanted almond eyes of ice blue with narrow vertical slit pupils, a thin tapering upper lash line and a fine eyelid crease; straight pale brows; a few small pale scales along the sides of the neck below the jaw; a small, firm, closed mouth; a neat small chin. Pale clean skin with very little shading, skin shadows a soft cool tone.
palette: snow white and gate-stone pale grey, ice blue, cord red, worn leather brown
casual: The vow-keeper's dress of the Snowscale clan: a long white felt robe to the shins with a high collar, the sleeves tied tight at the wrists with red cord so that her palms are free to press against the gate; around her throat a soft old leather throat guard, a padded collar handed down from her grandmother's generation, lined crookedly inside with wool; at her belt a short knife whose sheath is cut with seven upright lines, one for each gate; felt boots with iron-studded soles. Her palms are turned a little outward, showing the fine pale scales, an earnest, steady look.
private: Inside the clan's stone house under the rock ledge: a long-sleeved undyed wool tunic dress to the ankles, thick knitted stockings, felt slippers, the thin braid over her shoulder. She holds the old throat guard in her hands, stitching a new wool lining into it. A quiet, concentrated look.
battle: On the night of the scale-vow rite at the lowest gate: the white felt robe belted tight, a short grey felt cloak over the shoulders against the wind, the sleeves tied with red cord, the throat guard on, the iron-studded felt boots planted in the snow. One scaled palm is pressed flat forward as if against the gate, the other hand rests on the hilt of the short knife at her belt; she is reciting the vow.
battle_pose: 3) the vow-night outfit: braced and unmoving, the shoulders squared, the feet planted, a fierce, determined expression, one scaled palm pressed flat forward as if against a gate and the other hand on the hilt of the short knife at the belt.
formal: For the scale-vow rite before the clan's elders: a long white felt ceremonial robe with the clan's seven-line mark stitched small in grey at the collar, new red cords at the cuffs, a white felt hood laid back on the shoulders, the old throat guard, the short knife at her belt. She stands very straight with both palms pressed together in front of her, a solemn look. The ceremonial robe has narrow sleeves fitted to the wrist; each cuff is tied with a plain red cord finished in one small hard knot with short cut ends, no bow loops and no tassels. The seven-line mark is stitched small on the collar, not on the chest.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly, the ice-blue slit-pupilled eyes looking straight at the viewer, earnest and unafraid, the mouth closed, one scaled palm raised flat beside her face as if pressed to a gate. Cold blue snow light from one side, a faint red glow from the other, as from a gate lit from within. Foreground blur: falling snow, seven small keystones of different colours and a loose end of red cord. She wears the white felt robe with the high collar and the old throat guard.
art_extra: Her hair is snow white exactly as in the sprite; its shadows are a light neutral grey, NOT pink or lavender.

name: 尤恩·雪鳞
src: 迷宫纪前传/迷宫纪前传时段_四_深井的年月.md:325
who: Ewan of the Snowscale clan, a dragonborn guide at the Ice-Ridge outpost who came down from his clan's valley under the dragon gates and can never go back up, thirty-seven but looking twenty-seven or twenty-eight: about 186 cm, tall and lean with broad shoulders, taking long strides on snow. Snow-white hair cropped very short, dry at the temples from the snow glare. Ice-blue eyes with narrow vertical slit pupils, fine lines at their corners from looking at snow. Pale scales on his forearms and the back of his neck; on the left forearm a bare strip a finger wide and three inches long, where he has pulled out his own scales one by one to mark trails. A quiet, steady air; he pauses longer than anyone before he answers. The bare strip on his left forearm (on the viewer's right when he faces us) runs lengthwise along the forearm, a finger wide and three inches long, not a band around the arm.
face: FACE, as in the references: a lean man's face of about twenty-eight, quiet and steady: narrow almond eyes of ice blue with vertical slit pupils, fine lines at their corners; straight pale brows; a straight nose; a closed, patient mouth; a clean angular jaw. A few small pale scales at the sides of the neck. Clean skin with very little shading, skin shadows a soft cool tone.
build: 186 cm, tall and lean: broad shoulders, a strong back and long legs.
palette: snow white and pale grey felt, ice blue, rope brown, a little iron
casual: His guide's gear: a thick felt guide's coat to the knee with the collar turned up against the wind, the cuffs worn shiny, a wide belt, dark wool trousers and iron-studded felt boots; a coil of rope and an ice axe on his back; a string of old pale scales tied on a leather thong at his belt, for marking trails; around his throat an old leather throat guard, the twin of his sister's. One hand rests on the strap of the rope coil, a quiet, watchful look.
private: In the guides' room of the outpost: a loose undyed wool shirt with the sleeves pushed up, showing the bare strip on his left forearm, dark wool trousers, thick socks. He rubs the old throat guard with an oiled cloth, as he does each year before the rite. A calm, inward look.
battle: Taking a party up a storm slope: the felt coat buttoned to the turned-up collar, leather gloves, the coil of rope looped across his body and tied to the next climber, a pale scale ready in his left hand to drive into the snow; he grips the ice axe in his right hand, a still, alert look, listening to the ice.
formal: On the Frost-Sleep altar for the vow night of the golden-ear month: a long grey felt robe belted with a woven cord over his coat, the throat guard polished with oil, and over one forearm a deep-blue headscarf folded neatly, a keepsake. He stands very straight, the hands at his sides, a grave, quiet look. The grey felt robe is a plain Western pilgrim's robe: a round closed neckline with no crossed or overlapping front, fitted sleeves narrowing to the wrist, closed with a few plain buttons; the woven cord is tied once at the waist with short plain ends; no tassels, no toggle or frog fastenings, no wide sleeves, no wide sash.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the ice-blue slit-pupilled eyes looking past the viewer toward a far mountain, the lips just parted as if about to speak the last line of a vow. Cold blue snow light from one side; on a distant mountainside behind him seven bands of light rise one above another. Foreground blur: driving snow, a string of pale scales on a thong and the edge of a folded deep-blue headscarf. He wears the thick felt guide's coat with the collar turned up.

name: 凡妮莎·廷特
src: 迷宫纪前传/迷宫纪前传时段_四_深井的年月.md:516
who: Vanessa Tint, a human apprentice clerk at the door desk of the guild's commission hall, from a family that has written letters for the unlettered of the lower city's Grey Lane for four generations, nineteen: small, about 157 cm, with a small face and a pointed chin. Pale lilac hair in one braid coiled tightly at the back of the head, not a hair out of place; the end of the braid is black, stained by lamp soot when she was small and never washed out. Blue-green eyes that look at people's hands before their faces. An iron pen tucked behind her right ear, which she takes out and puts back when she is nervous. Timid, earnest and stubborn; her hands shake, her letters never do.
build: 157 cm, small and light: a small bust, a narrow waist and gently rounded hips.
palette: deep teal and black, pale lilac, soot black, ink blue-black, a little wax amber
casual: The commission-hall clerk's dress: a long deep teal robe with a high collar buttoned to the throat, old black sleeve protectors spotted all over with ink, a narrow belt with a small ink bottle hanging from it, its stopper sealed with wax, holding her family's lamp-soot ink; the guild's bronze apprentice emblem, a small unopened star over a simple compass, on a cord at the chest; plain dark shoes. She holds a palm-sized register wrapped in oilcloth against her chest with both hands, a nervous, earnest look.
private: At home in the lamp-lit Grey Lane: a plain long-sleeved cream blouse buttoned high, a long dark grey wool skirt, a soot-smudged apron, the braid let down over one shoulder so its black end shows. She holds a lamp chimney and a small knife, scraping off the soot for ink. A quiet, absorbed look.
battle: On the night watch at the commission hall: the deep teal robe with a dark wool shawl over it, the sleeve protectors on, the wax-sealed ink bottle at her belt, a small shielded lamp hanging at her waist. She holds the register open in one hand and the iron pen in the other, about to sign, the hand trembling but the point steady.
battle_pose: 3) the night-watch outfit: tense and determined, the shoulders squared, the feet a little apart, the lips pressed tight, holding the open register in one hand and the iron pen in the other; she does not fight.
formal: At the Ceasefire Day reading of names: a long deep blue wool robe with a high collar and a white band at the throat, clean black sleeve protectors, the apprentice emblem on its cord, the braid freshly coiled. She holds the list of names in both hands in front of her, very upright, a grave, slightly frightened look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the blue-green eyes glancing at the viewer's hands before rising to the face, the iron pen half drawn from behind her ear, a small, determined frown. Warm lamplight from one side over a desk at night. Foreground blur: a thumb pressing a seal onto paper, drifting lamp soot and the corner of a small register open at its first page. She wears the deep teal clerk's robe with the ink-spotted sleeve protectors.
art_extra: Her hair is pale lilac, a cool greyish lavender exactly as in the sprite, not pink; the warm lamplight only rims its edges.

name: 翁贝托·铜鳞
src: 迷宫纪前传/迷宫纪前传时段_四_深井的年月.md:572
who: Umberto of the Copperscale line, called Old Copper, a dragonborn who once breathed fire for the parties of the deep and now runs the kitchen behind the guild's emblem hall, about a hundred and fifty but looking around sixty: about 196 cm, tall and broad-backed, with a chest as thick as a barrel and a heavy waist; he walks slowly and never sways. Patches of dark copper scales on his cheekbones, the sides of his neck and his forearms; the scale over his throat has faded to grey and is cracked with fine lines, burned by five days of fire. White hair cropped very short. Orange-gold eyes with slit pupils. Big thick hands, the knuckles covered in old burn scars. A gruff, sharp-tongued, soft-hearted air.
face: FACE, as in the references: a weathered dragonborn man's face of about sixty, broad and heavy-boned, NOT young: narrow orange-gold eyes with vertical slit pupils under heavy brows, deep lines at their corners and across the brow; patches of dark copper scales on the cheekbones; a broad nose; a gruff, down-turned mouth; a faded grey scale cracked with fine lines over the throat. Clean skin with very little shading, skin shadows a soft warm tone.
build: 196 cm, tall and heavy: a barrel chest, a broad back, a thick waist and big hands.
palette: dark copper and ash grey, washed canvas white, ember orange, cast-iron black
casual: His kitchen clothes: a coarse dark shirt with the sleeves rolled above the elbow, showing his scaled forearms, under a washed-out canvas apron with seven or eight pockets sewn on, holding spoons, salt, a flint and a roll of paper slips; dark trousers and heavy boots. He holds a long-handled copper ladle in one big hand, a gruff, scowling look.
private: Late at night by the stove, beside the narrow bed he keeps next to it: a loose undyed wool shirt, braces, dark trousers, worn slippers, the apron hung on a hook. He holds a covered bowl in both hands, the portion kept back for someone who has not yet come up. A quiet, tired look.
battle: Feeding a whole expedition just come up from the deep: a heavy scorched leather apron tied over the canvas one, thick leather gauntlets against the heat, a cloth knotted over his head. He holds a big black iron pot against his side by one handle and the long-handled copper ladle in the other hand.
battle_pose: 3) the full-fire kitchen outfit: braced and steady, the feet planted, a fierce, scowling expression, the big black iron pot held against his side by one handle and the long-handled copper ladle raised in the other hand; he no longer fights.
formal: At the Ceasefire Day reading of names in the guild hall: a clean dark brown wool coat buttoned to the throat over a white shirt, the apron off for once, the roll of paper slips in his breast pocket. He stands upright with the big scarred hands folded in front, a gruff, grave look.
art: A portrait from slightly below with the camera tilted, the face large, the orange-gold slit-pupilled eyes looking down at the viewer, gruff, the lips pursed to blow one long warm breath over a steaming bowl held up in his big scarred hands. Warm red-orange stove light from one side. Foreground blur: steam, drifting sparks and small paper slips. He wears the washed canvas apron with many pockets.

name: 伯娜·冬仓
src: 迷宫纪前传/迷宫纪前传时段_四_深井的年月.md:628
who: Berna Wintergranary, a bear-eared beastfolk woman from a mining valley of the far north, rope-keeper of her brother's party at the shaft mouth, twenty-five: tall, about 184 cm, broad-shouldered and big-boned, a head taller than most people. Honey-coloured hair in one thick braid down her back. A pair of round bear ears whose tips have darker fur. Dark green eyes that look at people slowly and for a long time. Around her left wrist a white ring of a mark, like a bangle, left by a rope that went slack; she keeps it covered with a strip of old cloth. A slow, patient, unbudging air: she does not let go.
build: 184 cm, tall and big-boned: broad shoulders, thick strong hands, a very full bust, a solid waist and full hips.
palette: honey gold and dark green, bear-brown fur, hemp grey, a little winter white
casual: Her rope-keeper's clothes: a thick sleeveless leather vest from the northern mining valleys, worn fur side in, over a long-sleeved undyed wool shirt, dark wool trousers and heavy laced boots; a long rope twisted from bear fur and hemp coiled round and round her waist, tied with her family's knots; a strip of old cloth wrapped around her left wrist; the guild's bronze key-and-door-ring rank emblem on a cord at the chest. She holds the rope's end in her left hand, a slow, steady look.
private: In the guild's mess late at night: the vest off, a loose long-sleeved oatmeal wool shirt, the braid over one shoulder, soft boots, the cloth still on her wrist. She holds an empty bowl she has eaten slowly to the bottom, about to set it down upside down. A drowsy, quiet look.
battle: Holding the rope at a fog gate in the deep: the fur-lined vest under a boiled-leather jerkin, leather bracers, heavy boots, a lantern at her belt, the long bear-fur rope paid out from her waist, wound twice around her left wrist and gripped in both hands.
battle_pose: 3) the descent outfit: braced and immovable, the feet planted wide and the knees a little bent, a firm, silent expression, the rope wound around her left wrist and gripped in both hands as if holding a whole party falling below her; she carries no weapon.
formal: At the Ceasefire Day reading of names: a long dark green wool coat-dress from the north, buttoned to the throat, with white fur at the collar, the braid neatly tied with a cord in her family's knot, the key-and-door-ring emblem on its cord, the cloth still on her left wrist. She stands very still with the hands folded in front, a solemn look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the dark green eyes looking at the viewer slowly and steadily, her left hand raised near her face, the rope wound around the wrist over the old cloth. Cold white light from one side, as from a wall of fog. Foreground blur: drifting fog, a taut length of furred rope with a family knot in it and frost. She wears the thick fur-lined leather vest.

name: 妲西·灰径
src: 迷宫纪前传/迷宫纪前传时段_四_深井的年月.md:815
who: Darcy Greypath, a rabbit-eared beastfolk woman of the Greypath family, guides of the shaft mouth for six hundred years, a guild guide who has been down to the forty-eighth floor, thirty-one: about 158 cm, short, sturdy in the back and shoulders, long-legged. Snow-white hair in one thick braid down her back. A pair of long rabbit ears with grey tips, the family look; the right ear stands up, the left has been folded over halfway down since she was born. Pale cyan eyes that glance at people briefly and look at fog for a long time. A spare, brisk air; she counts her steps under her breath. Thick pale rope calluses across her palms and along the insides of her fingers; she wears no rings and no jewellery on her hands.
build: 158 cm, short and sturdy: a strong back and shoulders, long legs, a small bust, a narrow waist and gently rounded hips.
palette: snow white and ash grey, pale cyan, rope brown, a little brass
casual: Her guide's gear: a grey guide's short jacket with thick leather pads sewn on both shoulders, worn there by rope, over a dark shirt, slim dark trousers and soft boots; at her belt two coils of rope hung with small bells, a string of brass hooks and a short knife; the guild's bronze key-and-door-ring rank emblem on a cord at the chest; a backpack with a palm-wide new wooden board tied to the outside. She ties a knot in a length of rope between her hands, a brisk, focused look.
private: At home in the old Greypath house, whose wall is hung with a row of small wooden boards: a loose undyed wool sweater, a long dark skirt, soft slippers, the braid over one shoulder. She carves a small ring into one of the boards with a short knife, for someone who came back. A quiet, inward look.
battle: At a fog gate in the deep, guarding a party's rope: the grey jacket buttoned, leather gloves with the fingertips cut off, a lantern at her belt, the belled rope run out behind her and gripped taut in both hands; she has turned her back on what lies behind and will not look round.
battle_pose: 3) the fog-gate outfit: braced and still, the feet planted, a calm, unmoving expression, a belled rope gripped taut in both hands and running back behind her; she carries only a short knife at the belt.
formal: At the Ceasefire Day reading of names before the board of the unreturned: a long dark grey wool coat buttoned to the collar, a pale scarf, the key-and-door-ring emblem on its cord, the braid freshly tied, polished boots. She stands very straight with the hands folded, the upright ear lowered, a grave look. Her upright right ear is folded down flat against her hair; her hands are empty and folded.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the pale cyan eyes looking straight at the viewer, steady, her back turned to a wall of pale glowing fog that she will not look at; the folded left ear and the white braid close in the frame. Cold white light from the fog behind her rims her hair. Foreground blur: a taut rope with small bells and a wooden board with seven carved notches. She wears the grey guide's jacket with the leather shoulder pads.

name: 贝琳达·特劳布
src: 迷宫纪前传/迷宫纪前传时段_四_深井的年月.md:871
who: Belinda Traub, a human clerk at the counter of the guild's commission hall who copied deep-level maps in the map room for twelve years, thirty-two: tall, about 170 cm, slender and narrow-shouldered, leaning slightly forward from years over a desk. Pale cherry-pink hair pinned up in a bun with a copper pen stuck through it. A monocle over her left eye, on a fine chain hooked behind the ear; her right eye is mint green. A dark ink callus on the first joint of the right middle finger, the nails cut very short. A precise, unhurried, dry air: she reads to the last word before she looks up, and draws a line straighter than a ruler.
build: 170 cm, tall and slender: narrow shoulders, long hands, a small bust, a narrow waist and slim hips.
palette: deep blue and black, pale cherry pink, mint green, copper, a little brass
casual: The commission-hall clerk's dress: a long deep blue robe with a high collar buttoned to the throat, black sleeve protectors on both forearms, a narrow belt with an ink bottle, a spare pen and a ring of storeroom keys; the clerk's small mountain-copper plaque on a cord at the chest. She holds a commission slip up to read, a pen in the other hand, the monocle catching the light, a cool, attentive look.
private: At home in a lower-city lane hung with drying canvas: a soft cream blouse with the collar open, a long dark green wool skirt, a knitted grey cardigan, the hair let down from its bun. She holds the monocle between two fingers and polishes it with a cloth. A tired, faintly amused look.
battle: At the counter on the night a dangerous slip came in: the deep blue robe and black sleeve protectors, a dark wool over-robe against the cold of the storeroom, the ring of keys at her belt. She holds a slip of paper flat on a board in one hand and draws one dead-straight line across it with the pen in the other.
battle_pose: 3) the counter-duty outfit: composed and exact, the back straight, the feet together, a cool, stern expression, a slip of paper held flat on a board in one hand and the pen drawing one straight line across it in the other; she does not fight.
formal: Before the guild council's long table: a fitted deep blue wool coat-dress with a stand collar and small brass buttons, white cuffs, the copper plaque on its cord, the monocle on its chain, the bun neat with the copper pen. She stands very straight with a sealed folder held in both hands in front of her, a precise, composed look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the mint-green right eye and the monocled left eye lifting from a slip of paper to the viewer only after the last word, a dry half-smile. Cool white daylight from a high window on one side, glinting on the monocle. Foreground blur: a long ruled line of ink, the edge of a map sheet and a hanging ring of keys. She wears the deep blue clerk's robe with the black sleeve protectors.

name: 露西·晴锄
src: 迷宫纪前传/迷宫纪前传时段_四_深井的年月.md:927
who: Lucy Fairhoe, a human apprentice of the Research Institute's echo laboratory in the west, daughter of contract-folk farmers from the wheat fields outside the Ember City and the first of her family to read, twenty: small, about 153 cm, sturdy, a grown young woman. A round face with freckles across the nose and cheeks. Orange-red curly hair cut to the jaw, fluffy and untidy, a pencil often tucked behind one ear. Lake-blue eyes; she squints her left eye when she reads a needle. Blue-grey ink stains on her fingertips that never wash out. A quick, counting, chattering air: she reports a number before anything else.
face: FACE, as in the references: a round young woman's face of twenty, bright and earnest, NOT a child's: medium almond eyes of lake blue; light brows; freckles across the nose and cheeks; a small, quick mouth. Clean skin with very little shading, skin shadows a soft warm tone.
build: 153 cm, small and sturdy: a small bust, a narrow waist and slim hips.
palette: grey-white, orange-red, lake blue, brass, ink blue-grey
casual: The Research Institute apprentice's clothes: a short grey-white work smock with the sleeves rolled above the elbow over a dark shirt, slim brown trousers and sturdy shoes; a leather belt hung with a dozen small leather pouches, one needle in each; on her back a wooden case with brass corners, the lid shut. She balances a slender calibration needle on her open palm, the left eye squinted, counting, an intent look. The needle pouches are a row of small flat leather sleeves stitched along the belt like a tool roll, each showing the eye of one long hair-thin silver needle; they must not look like cartridges, bullets or brass shells.
private: In the apprentices' row at the east end of the Institute: a loose cream knitted sweater, a long brown skirt, thick socks, the curls messier than ever. She holds a small notebook and a pencil, counting the beams of the ceiling because she cannot sleep. A sleepy, absent look.
battle: Down in the deep with the Institute's party: the grey-white smock under a short leather jerkin, leather gloves with the fingertips cut off, a lantern at her belt, the brass-cornered case strapped tight on her back, the needle pouches at her belt. She holds a needle level on her palm in one hand and a pencil in the other. The flat leather needle sleeves at her belt are not cartridges.
battle_pose: 3) the field outfit: alert and careful, the feet a little apart, the left eye squinted in concentration, a slender needle held level on her palm in one hand and a pencil in the other; she does not fight.
formal: Called to give sworn testimony at the court of law: a clean grey-white Institute coat buttoned to the collar, a dark skirt, the curls combed down as far as they will go. She stands very upright with her right hand pressed flat over her heart, a pale, earnest look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly, the lake-blue eyes looking at the viewer, the left eye squinted as if reading a needle, a pencil behind her ear, the freckles bright. Warm lamplight from one side and the cold glint of a needle near her cheek. Foreground blur: a slender needle turning on a palm, pencilled tally marks and the brass corner of a wooden case. She wears the grey-white apprentice smock.

name: 胡萨姆·焙石
src: 迷宫纪前传/迷宫纪前传时段_四_深井的年月.md:983
who: Husam Hearthstone, a fire-horn demon-kin man of the contract folk of the Ember City, who bakes the bread in the back kitchen of the tavern at the shaft mouth, about a hundred and sixty but looking just past thirty: about 186 cm, broad-shouldered and thick-backed, his forearms always dusted with flour. Two horns curving back from the head, the root of the left horn wrapped with a band of white cloth against the heat. Short ochre-red hair. Ember-orange eyes like live coals; when he smiles, the right corner of his mouth moves first. Small burn scars on the backs of his hands from the oven mouth. A warm, talkative air that always comes back round to food.
face: FACE, as in the references: a man's face of about thirty, warm and open: narrow almond eyes of ember orange; straight ochre-red brows; a straight nose; a lopsided smile that lifts the right corner of the mouth first; a clean jaw. Clean skin with a faint warm red tint and very little shading, skin shadows a soft warm red-brown.
build: 186 cm, broad-shouldered and thick-backed, with strong forearms.
palette: flour white and ochre red, ember orange, oven-stone black, worn wood brown
casual: His baker's clothes: a washed-white apron over a dark linen shirt with the sleeves rolled to the elbow, flour on both forearms, brown trousers and worn boots; a wooden peel tucked in his belt and a clay jar of sourdough starter hanging from it; on his back, wrapped in cloth and tied on with a cord, a palm-sized piece of black oven stone that goes everywhere with him. He holds a round loaf in one hand, a warm, crooked grin.
private: In his small room above the kitchen: a loose cream linen shirt, braces, brown trousers, soft shoes, the white cloth still wound at his horn root. He holds a clay jar of starter up to the light, checking the marks scratched on it. A fond, absorbed look.
battle: Going down with an expedition to keep its fire: a heavy leather apron over a quilted jacket, leather gloves, a pack with a bag of flour and a sack of charcoal, the wooden peel in one hand and the piece of black oven stone, unwrapped, in the other.
battle_pose: 3) the deep-level outfit: steady and alert, the feet planted, a firm, cheerful expression, the wooden peel held in one hand and the piece of black oven stone in the other; he does not fight.
formal: On a feast day at the contract folk's mess in the Ember City: a clean dark red wool coat buttoned up over a white shirt, its black obsidian-steel buttons polished, a fresh white cloth at his horn root, the oven stone in its cloth on his back. He holds a basket with two loaves, one white and one dark rye, a proud, warm smile.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the ember-orange eyes smiling at the viewer, the right corner of the mouth up first, one floury hand tossing a small piece of bread into the fire. Warm red-orange firelight from one side. Foreground blur: drifting flour, sparks and the crust of a dark rye loaf. He wears the washed-white apron with the sleeves rolled up.

name: 奥尔文·凯德
src: 迷宫纪前传/迷宫纪前传时段_四_深井的年月.md:1161
who: Orven Kade, a human cartographer of the guild's deep survey bureau whose maps of the fortieth to fiftieth floors everyone uses, thirty-eight: tall, about 188 cm, thin and narrow-shouldered, his back bent slightly forward from years over a lamp table; long, slender fingers, the pads of the right forefinger and middle finger worn flat by the crystal pen. Messy dark brown-black hair shot through with silver, pushed back anyhow and held at both temples by two small bronze survey-bureau clips. His right eye is a deep steel grey, often bloodshot from long nights. His left eye is a prosthetic ground from a crystal of the shaft: faintly translucent, with tiny scattered points of light inside, like stars seen from the bottom of a well. No monocle and no glasses. A slow, exact, sharp-tongued air.
face: FACE, as in the references: a lean, tired man's face of about thirty-eight: narrow almond eyes; the right eye a deep steel grey, a little bloodshot; the left eye a prosthetic of pale translucent crystal with tiny scattered points of light inside and no clear pupil; straight dark brows; a straight nose; a thin, exact mouth; a clean jaw. Clean skin with very little shading, skin shadows a soft cool tone. The left eye (on the viewer's right when he faces us) is plainly a crystal prosthetic even at small size: pale blue-white and glassy, no dark pupil, a few tiny sparkles inside, clearly different from the steel-grey right eye.
build: 188 cm, tall and thin: narrow shoulders, long arms, the back bent a little forward.
palette: deep slate grey, lamp amber, bronze, pale crystal blue-white, oiled-paper cream
casual: The survey bureau's dress: a long deep slate-grey cloak whose inner side is lined with a row of flat pockets full of folded maps, over a dark high-collared shirt, a grey waistcoat and dark trousers tucked into boots; at the belt a leather case holding five crystal-tipped pens, a roll of oiled paper and a bronze scale ruler; at the back of the belt a short sword in a plain sheath; on a leather cord at his neck the guild's bronze star-chart rank emblem, an astrolabe with linked stars. He holds a crystal pen in one hand and a folded map in the other, a tired, exact look.
private: In the map room after a night at the lamp table: the cloak off, a dark wool shirt with the sleeves rolled up, the grey waistcoat unbuttoned, soft shoes, the bronze clips still in his hair. He holds a cold cup of tea, about to set it back in its corner of the table. A tired, faintly sheepish look.
battle: Leading the joint expedition down to the fifty-sixth floor: the slate-grey cloak belted close, a leather harness over the waistcoat with the pen case and an ink flask, leather gloves with two fingertips cut off, a thin measuring cord hanging from each bronze hair clip, sturdy boots. He holds a crystal pen raised in his right hand, its tip drawing a line of pale light in the air, and a sheet of oiled paper in his left; the short sword stays sheathed at his back.
battle_pose: 3) the expedition outfit: tense and focused, the shoulders squared, the feet a little apart, a crystal pen raised in one hand drawing a thin line of light and a sheet of oiled paper in the other; the short sword stays sheathed.
formal: At the survey bureau's showing of new maps: the slate-grey cloak brushed clean over a dark grey high-collared coat buttoned up, the star-chart emblem on its cord outside, the hair clips set straight for once. He holds a rolled map tied with cord under one arm, a stiff, slightly uneasy look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the head bowed over an unseen map and only the eyes lifting to the viewer, the crystal left eye glittering with tiny points of light, the steel-grey right eye tired and red-rimmed. Warm lamplight rising from below on one side, as through oiled paper on a lamp table. Foreground blur: layered sheets of oiled paper marked with faint red circles, a crystal pen tip trailing light and a cup at the corner of a table. He wears the deep slate-grey survey cloak with folded maps in its lining.

name: 策琳·施莱伯
src: 迷宫纪前传/迷宫纪前传时段_四_深井的年月.md:1217
who: Zerline Schreiber, a human company clerk of the Dawn battalion of the Federation's expeditionary army, from four generations of army clerks on the barracks street of the Golden Kite city, twenty-eight: about 162 cm, evenly built, her back straight, a writing board always held against her chest. Short curly honey-gold hair, a spare pen tucked behind her ear; in the deep she ties a short red thread round it so she can find it in the dark. Light green eyes that watch a speaker's mouth. A fair face, usually with a spot of ink on the tip of her nose that she does not know about. A black ink callus on the first joint of her right middle finger. A quick, exact, sharp-tongued air. The Dawn battalion's badge on the left breast (on the viewer's right when she faces us) is a small gold bird of prey with spread wings, a kite, the hawk-like bird; it is not a diamond or rhombus. The short red thread is tied only round the spare pen, a plain thread with short ends; there is no red ribbon, bow or tassel in her hair or on the pen.
build: 162 cm, evenly built: slim wrists, a straight back, a medium bust, a narrow waist and gently rounded hips.
palette: Federation deep blue and kite gold, honey gold, light green, ink black, a thread of red
casual: The expeditionary army clerk's uniform: a fitted deep blue coat with a stand collar, the Dawn battalion's golden kite badge sewn on the left breast, the cuffs faced with leather against ink, slim dark trousers and boots; a writing board hung at her chest with an oilcloth-wrapped notebook clipped to it and a screw-capped brass ink pot tied to its corner; a flat pouch at the belt with three pens, a roll of bandage and a small packet of dry bread. Her pen is already on the page, a quick, alert look.
private: At home on the barracks street, in the room of bundled notebooks: a soft cream blouse with the sleeves rolled, a long grey wool skirt, a knitted green shawl, house shoes. She reads an old notebook with a round stamp on its cover, a finger on a small pencilled circle in the margin. A quiet, thoughtful look.
battle: Down in the deep with the joint expedition: the deep blue coat under a light leather harness and a short field cape, leather gloves with the right thumb and forefinger cut away, the writing board strapped to her chest, the red thread tied on her pen, the brass ink pot at the board's corner.
battle_pose: 3) the expedition outfit: alert and tense, the feet a little apart, a firm expression, the writing board braced on one forearm and the pen poised over it; she carries no weapon.
formal: As the Federation's clerk at a joint review in the commission hall: a fitted dark blue dress coat with gold piping on the stand collar and cuffs, the golden kite badge polished, white gloves, the writing board under one arm. She stands very straight, a composed, slightly proud look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the light green eyes fixed on the viewer's mouth as if writing down every word, a pen with a red thread raised near her cheek, a spot of ink on the tip of her nose. Cool lantern light from one side in the dark of a deep shaft. Foreground blur: the corner of a writing board, a brass ink pot and a small pencilled circle in a page margin. She wears the deep blue clerk's coat with the golden kite badge.

name: 久洛·潮栏
src: 迷宫纪前传/迷宫纪前传时段_四_深井的年月.md:1273
who: Gyula Tidegate, a demon-kin man of the deep-tide snake folk from the harbour of the sea fortress, company clerk of the Obsidian Empire's deep expeditionary army, fifty-two but looking just past thirty: about 183 cm, tall and lean with wide shoulders, and four arms, the upper pair thicker, for writing, the lower pair slender and nimble, for the hourglass, the lamp and the rope. Fine silvery-white scales with a hint of cyan, like the inside of a shell, on his neck, the backs of his hands and all four forearms. Short coral-red hair with one long thin braid at the nape. Pale violet eyes with slit pupils and a forked tongue that shows when he talks fast. A small tide table tattooed inside the wrist of his lower left hand. A dry, deadpan air.
face: FACE, as in the references: a lean man's face of about thirty, dry and composed: narrow almond eyes of pale violet with vertical slit pupils; straight coral-red brows; fine silvery-cyan scales along the sides of the neck; a thin, deadpan mouth; a clean jaw. Pale clean skin with very little shading, skin shadows a soft cool sea-green tone.
build: 183 cm, tall and lean with wide shoulders and four arms: the upper pair thicker, the lower pair slender and nimble.
palette: Obsidian black and bronze, coral red, shell silver-cyan, pale violet, a little sand gold
casual: The deep expeditionary army clerk's uniform: a long black coat cut with four sleeves and a stand collar buttoned to the throat, the bronze badge of the Contract Office on the left breast, slim dark trousers and boots; two notebooks hanging at his belt, one for counts and one for names, and a small hourglass. His upper hands hold a bone pen and an open notebook; the lower left hand holds a thin knotted cord and the lower right the hourglass. A dry, deadpan look.
private: Off duty in the harbour of the sea fortress: a loose sea-blue linen shirt with four short sleeves, grey trousers, bare feet. The upper hands rest folded while the lower hands run along the knots of the thin cord. A calm, idle look.
battle: Counting the beat on the fifty-sixth floor: the black four-sleeved coat under a leather harness, leather bracers on all four forearms, the two notebooks strapped at his belt beside the hourglass. His upper hands hold a notebook and the bone pen, his lower hands a lantern and the knotted cord.
battle_pose: 3) the expedition outfit: steady and tense, the feet a little apart, a firm expression, the upper hands holding a notebook and a bone pen and the lower hands a lantern and a knotted cord; he carries no weapon.
formal: Carrying the book of names home to the Bell-Tower Tomb City: a long black dress coat with four sleeves, a stand collar and a row of bronze buttons, the Contract Office badge polished, a dark sea-blue sash. His upper hands hold the book of names closed, the lower hands folded below it, a grave look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the pale violet slit-pupilled eyes looking at the viewer with deadpan humour, the tip of a forked tongue just showing, two of his hands raised near his face, one holding an hourglass with the sand still running. Cool blue-green light from one side, as off water. Foreground blur: a knotted cord, falling grains of sand and the corner of an open notebook. He wears the black four-sleeved clerk's coat.

name: 坎黛丝·焰沙
src: 迷宫纪前传/迷宫纪前传时段_四_深井的年月.md:1329
who: Candace Flamesand, a fire-horn demon-kin woman from the glassblowers' street of the Horned Flame City, captain of the Eleventh battalion of the Obsidian deep expeditionary army, about a hundred and sixty but looking just past thirty: tall, about 180 cm, broad-shouldered, thick-backed and long-legged. Skin with the red cast of fired clay, a glow of fire at the hollow of the throat. Two horns curving back from the temples, sheathed in mountain-copper horn sleeves pierced with small vents that glow red. Hair charcoal black at the roots and orange-red toward the ends like burning coal, in one thick braid to the waist. Pale cyan eyes like new glass. A faint scar across the left brow bone. Her right arm, from the shoulder down, is an electro-mechanical prosthetic of black obsidian steel. A loud, quick-tempered, protective air.
face: FACE, as in the references: a strong woman's face of about thirty: medium almond eyes of pale cyan, clear as glass; strong dark brows; a faint pale scar across the left brow bone; a wide mouth quick to grin. Skin with a warm red-clay tint and very little shading, skin shadows a soft warm red-brown, a faint orange glow at the hollow of the throat.
build: 180 cm, tall and powerful: broad shoulders, a thick back, a very full bust, a firm waist and full hips, long legs; the right shoulder sits a little lower than the left.
palette: Obsidian black and deep red, red clay, ember orange, pale cyan glass, mountain copper
casual: Her captain's armour: the black-and-red plate of the deep expeditionary army, the breastplate branded with the army's well mark, the left pauldron engraved with her battalion's mark, over a dark red padded coat, dark trousers and armoured boots; a broad-bladed short sword at her left hip, the blade scorched black near the hilt by her horn fire; on her back a battery cell wrapped in oilcloth and strapped on with two leather belts, feeding the black steel arm through a ring of dragon-crystal sockets at the shoulder. She rests the steel hand on her hip, a loud, cocky grin.
private: On leave in the glassblowers' street: a loose dark red linen shirt with the left sleeve rolled up, the black steel right arm bare, wide dark trousers and soft boots, only two vents open in her horn sleeves. She holds a small red-tinted glass cup in the steel hand. A relaxed, warm look.
battle: Holding a closing gap: the black-and-red plate buckled tight, the battery cell on her back, every vent in her horn sleeves thrown open and glowing. She grips the broad-bladed short sword in her left hand and braces the black steel right arm forward, palm open, as if holding up a falling wall; a fierce grin.
formal: On Ceasefire Day, reading three names: a long black dress coat of the expeditionary army with dark red facings, a stand collar and bronze buttons, a battalion sash, the horn sleeves polished, a black glove on the steel hand. She stands upright with the hands at her sides, a grave, slow look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the pale cyan eyes laughing at the viewer, the copper horn sleeves with every vent glowing red, the black steel hand raised near her face. Hot ember-orange light from one side, as from a glass kiln. Foreground blur: drifting sparks, a red-tinted glass shard and the bronze tip of a tall marker pole. She wears the black-and-red captain's plate.

name: 麦格尼·石雷
src: 迷宫纪前传/迷宫纪前传时段_四_深井的年月.md:1481
who: Magni Stonethunder, a dwarf of the cliff line of the forge city who carries the shield for the miners under the Roaring Cliff, a hundred and seventeen, in a dwarf's prime: about 141 cm, short but as wide as a wall, with a heavy infantryman's weight in his shoulders, his shield arm and his legs. Short rust-copper hair with grey at the temples, bare-headed, no circlet. A brow like a block of granite and an old scar across the bridge of the nose from a falling rock. A big rust-copper beard braided into one thick plait, its end clasped with a copper ring. Deep-set dark brown eyes that look at a person's knees before the face. A quiet, steady, wall-like air.
face: FACE, as in the references: a dwarf's face in the prime of life, broad and weathered, NOT old and NOT a child's: deep-set dark brown eyes under a heavy granite brow; an old scar across the bridge of the nose; a big nose; ruddy cheeks; a firm mouth half hidden by the moustache; a big beard in one thick braid ending in a copper ring. Clean skin with very little shading; skin shadows a soft warm tone.
build: 141 cm, short, very broad and thick: heavy shoulders, a thick shield arm and strong legs.
palette: rust copper and dark iron, dragon-bone grey-white, worn leather brown, a little copper
casual: His mine-guard's gear: an old coat of scale armour forged at the cliff's anvils, the plates on the left shoulder dented by falling rock and never replaced, over a padded dark shirt, heavy trousers and iron-shod boots; a leather pouch at his belt full of food that the miners' families press on him. On his left arm a tower shield as tall as he is, mountain copper mixed with the dust of ancient dragon bone, grey-white with a bony sheen; in his right hand a short-handled thunder hammer, held low. He stands planted, a quiet, watchful look.
private: At home under the falls after the shift bell: a thick undyed wool tunic with the sleeves pushed up over strong forearms, a leather vest, wool trousers, heavy house boots. He holds a heel of bread and a piece of cheese from the pouch, about to share them out. A tired, kind look.
battle: Holding a tunnel mouth: the dented scale armour buckled tight, leather gauntlets, the dragon-bone tower shield raised on his left arm with its lower edge planted, the short-handled thunder hammer gripped in his right hand, the knees bent as if taking the weight of a mountain; a grim, steady look.
formal: Called up to the cliff's long hall: a dark grey wool coat with plain iron buttons over a clean shirt, the scale armour left at home, the beard freshly braided with its copper ring. He stands very straight, the thick hands at his sides, gruff and uneasy in his best.
art: A heavy low-angle portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the dark brown eyes looking down at the viewer, quiet and steady; behind him three cracked pieces of an old shield hang on a rock wall. Warm mine-lamp light from one side against the cold blue mist of a waterfall. Foreground blur: waterfall spray, falling stone dust and the grey-white bony rim of the tower shield. He wears the old dented scale armour.

name: 劳珂·鸣铜
src: 迷宫纪前传/迷宫纪前传时段_四_深井的年月.md:1537
who: Lauke Bellbronze, a dwarf woman of the cliff line from a family of bell-keepers, who keeps the shift bell and the board of name tags on the stone platform beside the Iron Falls, about a hundred and fifty, in a dwarf's prime: short, about 129 cm, stout and broad-shouldered, her arms thick from pulling the bell rope. Rust-red hair in two thick braids coiled on top of her head, a copper spike for nailing hooks stuck through them. Moss-green eyes. Round cheeks flushed red by the waterfall's mist. A small copper bell hanging from her right earlobe. A loud, talkative, warm air: every third thing she says is a count.
face: FACE, as in the references: a dwarf woman's face in her prime, broad and cheerful, NOT a child's: medium almond eyes of moss green; strong level brows; round cheeks flushed red by the mist; a small nose; a wide, talkative mouth. Clean skin with very little shading; skin shadows a soft warm pink.
build: 129 cm, short, stout and broad-shouldered: thick strong arms, a full bust, a solid waist and broad hips.
palette: rust red and moss green, oilcloth olive, bright copper, waterfall grey-white
casual: Her bell-keeper's clothes: a long oilcloth apron with a row of pockets across the front, holding copper name tags, nails and a small file, over a long-sleeved rust-brown wool dress and a dark shawl; leather gloves with a hole worn through the palm and patched three times; boots with iron-shod heels. She holds a copper tag up in one gloved hand, about to hang it on a hook, a loud, cheerful look.
private: In the stone house under the bell platform: a loose oatmeal wool dress with the sleeves pushed up, a knitted shawl, felt slippers, the braids still coiled with the copper spike. She rubs a newly cut copper tag bright on her sleeve. A warm, absent smile.
battle: Ringing the retreat all night: the oilcloth apron tied tight over a padded jacket, a hooded oilcloth cape against the spray, the patched gloves gripping a thick hemp bell rope with both hands.
battle_pose: 3) the alarm outfit: braced and urgent, the feet planted wide, a fierce expression, both gloved hands hauling down on a thick bell rope; she carries no weapon.
formal: On a feast day of the cliff: a long dark green wool dress with a high collar and copper buttons, a clean white apron, the braids freshly coiled with the copper spike polished, the little bell at her ear. She stands upright with the hands folded, a proud, beaming look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the moss-green eyes bright, one gloved hand touching the little copper bell at her ear as she listens. Cool silver-blue light of waterfall spray from one side, glinting on copper. Foreground blur: waterfall mist, a row of copper tags on hooks and a swinging bell rope. She wears the long oilcloth apron with its row of pockets.

name: 菲莱雅·石火
src: 迷宫纪前传/迷宫纪前传时段_四_深井的年月.md:1593
who: Phileia Stonefire, a tiefling of the lower city trained at the Starfall academy, captain of the party Before-the-Thunder, which guards the mines under the Roaring Cliff, thirty-six but looking twenty-seven or twenty-eight: about 171 cm, tall, long-legged and narrow-waisted, the shoulders built by the long spear. Pomegranate-red short hair tied in a small knot at the back. Two short horns on the forehead curving back, the tip of the left one broken off. Orange-gold eyes that show a faint red ring in the dark. Thin pale-gold lines run along both forearms like burnt copper wire. A slender long tail ending in a tuft of hard scales. A quick, prickly, self-mocking air. Her leather pouch is tied shut with a plain thin red cord wound tight round its neck and finished in one small hard knot with short cut ends: no bow, no decorative knot, no tassel.
build: 171 cm, tall and slender: long legs, a narrow waist, strong shoulders, a medium bust and gently rounded hips.
palette: pomegranate red and orange gold, dark leather brown, iron grey, a little red cord
casual: Her mine-guard's gear: fitted leather armour with iron plates riveted at the elbows and knees, over a dark shirt, slim dark trousers and boots; a long spear on her back, its head long and slender with a fuller groove; at her belt a leather pouch tied tightly shut with a red cord; a copper tag on a cord at her chest beside the guild's bronze star-chart rank emblem. Her tail sweeps low behind her; she stands with one hand on the pouch, a sharp, guarded look.
private: In the stone hall by the falls after a shift: a loose dark red linen shirt with the sleeves rolled, wide dark trousers, soft boots, the hair let out of its knot. She holds a big bowl of stew and a spoon, eating more than anyone, a hungry, lopsided grin. Her short hair, let loose, falls only to the jaw.
battle: Down the third tunnel: the leather armour buckled tight, leather bracers, the red-tied pouch at her belt, the tail braced for balance. She grips the long spear low in both hands, its slender head forward, ready to slip it into a seam; a fierce, focused look, the eyes ringed faint red.
formal: Handing three emblems in at the guild's settlement counter: a clean dark red wool short coat buttoned to the collar over a white shirt, slim dark trousers and polished boots, the star-chart emblem on its cord. She holds the leather pouch tied with red cord in both hands in front of her, very upright, a stiff, pale look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the orange-gold eyes ringed faint red in the dark, a crooked, self-mocking grin, her breath misting on the slender spearhead raised beside her face. A warm mine lamp from one side in deep darkness. Foreground blur: drifting dust, a red cord on a leather pouch and the scaled tip of her tail. She wears the fitted leather armour with the iron elbow plates.

name: 米蕾卡·斯温
src: 迷宫纪前传/迷宫纪前传时段_四_深井的年月.md:1740
who: Mireka Swain, a human mender at the guild's echo appraisal office, from a family of lower-city menders who patched clothes for the upper-ring households so that the patches never showed, thirty-four: about 160 cm, slender, with long fingers. Honey-gold hair with darker amber roots, loosely put up and held with a few ordinary steel sewing needles, no headband. Warm amber eyes, tired but bright; she looks at the edges of things first. A thimble callus around her left forefinger. Her own sleeves are patched on the outside, every patch a different colour. A soft, careful, gentle air: she always asks before she mends. Her face is unmarked: no scar and no stitches on either cheek, and no earrings.
build: 160 cm, slender and slight: long fingers, a small bust, a narrow waist and slim hips.
palette: grey-white, honey gold, warm amber, a patchwork of thread colours, a little steel
casual: The appraisal office's working dress: a long grey-white work smock over a high-necked blouse and a long dark skirt, the sleeves patched all over on the outside, each patch a different colour, sewn by her own uneven hand; a belt hung with many thread spools strung on leather cords, one colour and one fibre each; thin leather gloves with the fingertips cut off; a small cloth pouch at the chest holding a thimble and her mother's small scissors; the guild's bronze star-chart rank emblem on a cord. She holds a needle and thread up to the light, a soft, tired, attentive look.
private: At home in the half-sunken room whose window is level with the street: a soft knitted cardigan over a plain high-necked blouse, a long brown skirt, thick socks, the hair down in a loose braid. She holds a lopsided little cloth bird sewn from an old garment. A sleepy, fond smile.
battle: Mending through seven nights in the dark streets behind the sealed store: the grey-white smock under a dark wool shawl tied crosswise, the cut-fingered gloves, every thread spool at her belt, a small lamp hung on her left side so that her shadow falls to the right. She holds a long needle raised in one hand, a faint thread of light trailing from it down to her shadow, and a spool in the other.
battle_pose: 3) the mending outfit: tense and focused, the feet a little apart, a steady expression, a long sewing needle raised in one hand with a thread of faint light trailing down from it and a spool in the other; she does not fight.
formal: At the appraisal office's yearly showing: a long high-necked plum-grey wool dress with long sleeves, one patch of a different colour sewn openly at the elbow, a short dark shawl, the thimble on a fine chain at her neck, the hair neatly pinned with the sewing needles. She stands upright with her hands folded, a quiet, composed look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the warm amber eyes looking at the viewer from under lowered lashes, tired but bright, a needle raised near her cheek drawing a thread of faint light. Soft lamplight from one side, her shadow falling dark across the other. Foreground blur: dangling threads of many colours, a thimble and a lopsided little cloth bird. She wears the grey-white work smock with the many-coloured patches.

name: 泰里昂·叩扉
src: 迷宫纪前传/迷宫纪前传时段_四_深井的年月.md:1796
who: Therion Knockdoor, a demon-kin man of the dream-walker folk from the Mirror City of Nightmares, the dream physician of the Obsidian outpost in the upper ring, about two hundred and forty but looking just past thirty: about 183 cm, tall and thin, narrow-shouldered, light on his feet. Long pearl-white hair with the ends tinged violet, tied at the nape with a black cord. Honey-coloured eyes, half-lidded, as if he had just woken. His shadow lags half a beat behind him. A black stone ring on his right middle finger. A slow, lazy, yawning air that never misses a thing.
build: 183 cm, tall and thin: narrow shoulders, long fingers, a straight back.
palette: deep violet and pearl white, honey gold, chalk white, black stone
casual: The dream physician's robe of the Mirror City's dream clinic: a long deep violet robe with a high collar, the cuffs embroidered with the clinic's sign, a door standing half open; a dark sash; at his waist a small leather case holding a few vials of sleeping draught and a stick of white chalk; soft dark boots; the black stone ring on his right middle finger. He raises his right hand loosely, the ringed knuckle ready to knock, a sleepy, patient look. The robe is cut like a Western physician's long coat: a high stand collar buttoned at the throat, a single row of small buttons down the front, a plain shirt and waistcoat under it with no crossed or overlapping collars, sleeves fitted to the wrist; the dark sash is a narrow belt-sash, not a wide waist wrap.
private: In his room at the outpost, awake as always at night: a loose dark grey linen shirt, a black knitted vest, soft trousers, house slippers, the hair let down. He holds a cup of something warm and stifles a yawn. A lazy, amused look.
battle: Walking into seven hundred dreams: the deep violet robe belted close, a dark short cape, the leather case of vials at his waist. He raises his right hand with the ringed knuckle about to knock three times and holds a stick of white chalk in his left. The short cape is fastened at the throat with one plain round button; no tassels, no ornamental clasps, no crossed collar.
battle_pose: 3) the dream-walking outfit: calm and alert, the feet a little apart, an unhurried, steady expression, the right hand raised with the ringed knuckle about to knock and a stick of white chalk in the left; he does not fight.
formal: Before the dream-review court of his home city: a long black robe with a high collar, the half-open door embroidered in violet thread at the cuffs and breast, the black stone ring, the hair neatly tied. He stands very straight with the hands folded, a composed, faintly bored look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the honey eyes half-lidded and drowsy, looking at the viewer, the knuckle of his ringed finger raised as if about to knock on the frame. Soft violet night light from one side; his shadow on the wall behind lags half a beat behind his hand. Foreground blur: a chalk line on a bedpost, a half-open door and drifting pale motes like dreams. He wears the deep violet robe with the half-open door at the cuffs.
art_extra: His hair is pearl white from the roots down, exactly as in the sprite, on its lit side and its shadow side alike; only the last finger's width at the very ends is tinged violet; the hair framing his face is white, NOT lavender or pink; the violet light only rims its outermost edge.

name: 加斯帕·牧坡
src: 迷宫纪前传/迷宫纪前传时段_四_深井的年月.md:1852
who: Gaspar Shepherdslope, a dog-eared beastfolk man from a shepherd family on the north slope of the Dawnshine plain, a deep-level guide and captain of the party Star-Sniffers, forty-six but looking just over fifty, since his folk age fast: about 164 cm, short and wiry, the back a little stooped from carrying. A pair of drooping dog ears with wheat-straw yellow fur, the tips gone white. Warm gold eyes. Stubble half gone white; when he smiles, which is seldom, the corners of his eyes crease deeply. A bushy tail with a bald patch near the tip. A sheep bell on a cord at his throat. A rough, hot-tempered, protective air.
face: FACE, as in the references: a weathered man's face of about fifty: narrow almond eyes of warm gold with deep creases at their corners; bushy brows; a straight nose; a firm, rough mouth; stubble on the jaw, half of it white. Clean skin with very little shading; skin shadows a soft warm tone.
build: 164 cm, short and wiry: lean, the back a little stooped from carrying loads.
palette: wheat-straw yellow and white, warm gold, oilcloth olive-brown, polished brass
casual: His guide's gear: a short oilcloth cape with two leather patches on the shoulders, worn by the straps, over a brown wool jacket, dark trousers and old boots; a brass lamp hanging at his belt, its shade polished bright, its pole wrapped in leather cord; an empty wooden case on his back; the sheep bell on its cord at his throat; the guild's bronze star-chart rank emblem pinned at the chest. He holds the lamp up by its pole, the wrist dead still, a gruff, watchful look.
private: At home on the lane that slopes down to the shaft mouth: a loose cream wool shirt, a brown knitted vest, old trousers and worn slippers. He polishes the lamp shade with a cloth, counting under his breath. A tired, quiet look.
battle: Leading a party forty floors down: the oilcloth cape over a boiled-leather jerkin, leather gloves, the empty wooden case strapped tight on his back. He holds the brass lamp up in one hand, the wrist dead still, the other hand on the strap of the case.
battle_pose: 3) the deep-guide outfit: braced and steady, the feet planted, a fierce, gruff expression, the brass lamp held up in one hand with the wrist dead still and the other hand on the strap of the empty case on his back; he carries no weapon.
formal: Taking his daughter to the appraisal office as an apprentice: a clean dark brown wool coat buttoned to the collar over a white shirt, the star-chart emblem on its cord, the ears brushed, the sheep bell at his throat. He stands stiffly upright with the hands at his sides, a gruff, uncomfortable look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the warm gold eyes looking at the viewer from under the drooping ears, the brass lamp held up close to his face, its light perfectly steady. Warm lamplight from one side against deep blue darkness. Foreground blur: glowing blue shards like pieces of a broken sky, a sheep bell and the rim of an empty wooden case. He wears the short oilcloth cape with the leather shoulder patches.
art_extra: His hair is the warm neutral grey of the sprite, its shadows a darker warm grey, NOT blue, violet or blue-grey; his drooping dog ears stay wheat-straw yellow with white tips; the blue darkness only rims their outermost edge.

name: 维多利亚·韦洛
src: 迷宫纪前传/迷宫纪前传时段_四_深井的年月.md:2018
who: Victoria Vello, a human presiding judge of the Obsidian Court, who grew up in her father's petition-writing shop in the law village below the plateau, forty-four but looking just past thirty, since heroes age slowly: tall, about 177 cm, slender and spare, standing very straight; she sits a whole day on the bench without leaning back. Long straight black hair with a cold blue sheen, worn down, the front locks falling close along both cheeks. Grey-blue eyes that seldom blink. A short pencil tucked behind her left ear; ink on her fingertips under the gloves. An exact, cool, unreadable air.
build: 177 cm, tall, slender and spare: a straight back, a small bust, a narrow waist and slim hips.
palette: court black and ink blue, obsidian glass, graphite grey, a little antique gold
casual: Her judge's robe: a dark robe cut so close that not an inch of cloth is spare, a stand collar buttoned to the throat and pinned with a small plaque of black glass cut in the plateau's quarry; a plain dark belt with a short sword in a black leather sheath, the kind every escort officer of the court wears; thin leather gloves; polished dark boots. She carries a dossier case under one arm and holds a short pencil in her bare right hand, the right glove tucked into her belt, a cool, exact look.
private: At night in the clerks' house on the plateau: a plain dark grey high-necked blouse, a long charcoal skirt, flat shoes, the gloves off. She holds a pencil stub and a small knife, sharpening it down to the last inch. A tired, softening look.
battle: Taking a man in the escort corridor: the close-cut robe under a fitted black leather coat with a high collar, black gloves. She holds the short sword low and level in her right hand and a warrant held up in her left, about to read its one line aloud; a cool, unwavering look.
formal: On the bench at the top of the great stairs for the sentencing of thirty-two lords: the close-cut dark robe with a long black stole edged in thin antique gold, the black glass plaque at the collar, both gloves on. She stands very straight with her left hand flat on a closed book of law, a stern, still look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the grey-blue eyes lifting from a page to the viewer without blinking, a pencil stub raised in her bare right hand as she writes in a margin. Cold white light from a high window on one side. Foreground blur: curls of pencil shavings, crumbs of bread used to rub out pencil and the worn edge of an old folded petition. She wears the close-cut dark judge's robe with the black glass plaque at the collar.

name: 梅芙·头钟
src: 迷宫纪前传/迷宫纪前传时段_四_深井的年月.md:2073
who: Maeve Firstbell, a demon-kin woman of the white-bone folk from the Bell-Tower Tomb City, a clerk of the guild's recovery department who settles the slips for the dead and their belongings standing up, a hundred and twelve and looking just past thirty: about 165 cm, thin, her back always straight. Skin so white it is almost translucent; in the cold the shadows of the bones show beneath it. At the left corner of her brow a small patch of bare bone shows, carved with the notches of her number. Frost-white hair cut to the shoulders. Blue-green eyes like the water of the fortieth floor. The finger bones of her left hand show at the knuckles, worn bright by name tags. An old copper name tag hangs at her throat, its edges rubbed round. A slow, plain, gentle air.
face: FACE, as in the references: a calm woman's face of about thirty, plain and gentle: medium almond eyes of blue-green, like still deep water; level frost-white brows; a small patch of bare white bone at the left corner of the brow, carved with small notches; a quiet, closed mouth. Very pale, almost translucent skin with very little shading, skin shadows a soft cool grey-blue. The patch of bare bone at the left corner of her brow (on the viewer's right when she faces us) is always visible, never hidden by her hair: a coin-sized patch of smooth white bone in the skin just above the eyebrow, with a few small notches cut into it.
build: 165 cm, thin and straight-backed: a small bust, a narrow waist and slim hips.
palette: recovery grey, bone white, frost white, blue-green, old copper
casual: The recovery department clerk's dress: a long grey robe with the cuffs tied close and a guild cloth badge sewn on the chest, a narrow belt, soft dark boots; a leather bag over one shoulder holding the sealed register, a bottle of ink, a bone pen and a small knife for carving bone tags; the old copper name tag on its cord at her throat. She holds a slip of paper and the bone pen, standing straight, a calm, attentive look.
private: In her narrow room by the recovery department, where she spends the nights awake as her folk do: a long plain dark grey wool dress with a high collar, a knitted grey shawl, soft house shoes. She holds the old copper name tag from her throat in her palm, looking down at it. A quiet, patient look.
battle: Down in the shallow levels with a recovery team: the recovery department's deep grey heavy wool coat with leather pads sewn on the shoulders and the cuffs tied close, a lantern and a bundle of white cloth strips at her belt, the leather bag strapped tight. She holds a small bone tag in one hand and the bone pen in the other.
battle_pose: 3) the recovery outfit: steady and alert, the feet a little apart, a calm, firm expression, a small bone tag in one hand and the bone pen in the other; she carries no weapon.
formal: As the witness before the Obsidian Court: a clean grey high-collared robe buttoned to the throat, the guild cloth badge, the copper name tag outside the robe, the sealed register held in both hands against her chest. She stands very straight, a calm, grave look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the blue-green eyes looking at the viewer calmly, the notched bone at her brow catching the light, one hand lifting the old copper name tag from her throat. Cold blue-white light of a bell tower from one side. Foreground blur: a row of copper name tags on cords, drifting dust and the bronze rim of a great bell. She wears the long grey recovery-department robe.
